Ch133 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: descriptive set theory | ID: 2516

Assertion

Let X be a Lebesgue space with algebraic structure S. Then the cohomology group is finite-dimensional for all n.

Proof

Step 2. By compactness of the compact spectral family \(Q_{01330012}\), the image is precompact in the real manifold topology.

Step 3. Applying the positive interpolation theorem to \(P_{01330013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via Fourier interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
